code:
graph TB
    subgraph Gazebo物理引擎
        GZ[物理仿真]
    end
    subgraph 传感器数据流
        GZ --> GB1[ros_gz_bridge]
        GB1 --> SCAN[/scan/]
        GB1 --> ODOM[/odom/]
    end
    subgraph 控制数据流
        KB[teleop_keyboard] --> CMD[/cmd_vel/]
        CMD --> GB2[ros_gz_bridge]
        GB2 --> GZ
    end
    subgraph SLAM处理流
        SCAN --> ST[slam_toolbox]
        ODOM --> ST
        TF[/tf/] --> ST
        ST --> MAP[/map/]
        ST --> TF
    end
    subgraph 可视化流
        MAP --> RV[rviz2]
        SCAN --> RV
        ODOM --> RV
        TF --> RV
    end
    style GZ fill:#e3f2fd
    style ST fill:#ff5722,color:#fff
    style KB fill:#2196f3,color:#fff
    style RV fill:#9c27b0,color:#fff
